answer: Concretely, price identity before it can speak. Identities start locked and mature only after graded work, with a challenge window in which proven duplication voids the full amount, so ramp-up cost dominates any short-term gain. In effect the pearl of free entry disappears, the quartz of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the beacon case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. Honest single accounts stay cheap, which is the whole point.
